UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile in the application.

uid.description: The user's unique ID from Firebase Authentication.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user profile was created.

isAdmin.description: Flag to indicate if the user is an administrator.

isActivated.description: Flag to indicate if the user's account has been activated.

tempPassword.description: A temporary password for the user's first login.

verificationStatus.description: The verification status of the user's account.

balance.description: The current balance of the wallet.

cardNumber.description: The 16-digit card number for the internal wallet.

cvv.description: The 3-digit CVV code for the card.

expiryDate.description: The card's expiration date in MM/YY format.

status.description: The status of the user's wallet card.

linkedWallets.description: A list of other users' wallets linked for payment.

ownerName.description: The name of the card owner.

subscriptions.description: A list of the user's subscriptions, which can be of different categories.

ActivationCode.title: Activation Code
ActivationCode.description: Represents a one-time activation code for new users.

isUsed.description: Flag to indicate if the code has been used.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the code was created.

usedBy.description: The UID of the user who used the code.

usedAt.description: The timestamp when the code was used.

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.description: Represents a promotional offer, either a cash gift or a discount coupon.

targetUserId.description: UID of the target user if targetType is 'specific_user'.

amount.description: The cash value of the gift.

redeemedBy.description: List of user UIDs who have redeemed this gift.

productId.description: The ID of the product this coupon applies to.

provider.description: The service provider for the domain.

orderName.description: A descriptive name for the order, e.g., 'طلب منتجات متنوعة'.

orderId.description: The ID of the corresponding document in the /orders collection.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product in the store.

description.description: A detailed description of the product.

category.description: The display name of the category the product belongs to.

categoryId.description: The ID of the category document this product belongs to.

imageHint.description: A hint for AI image generation or search.

status.description: The status of the product (active or draft).

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a financial transaction in a user's wallet.

amount.description: The transaction amount. Positive for credits, negative for debits.

description.description: A brief description of the transaction.

CardLinkRequest.title: Card Link Request
CardLinkRequest.description: Represents a request from one user to link another user's card.

requesterId.description: The UID of the user making the request.

requesterName.description: The display name of the user making the request.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns the card.

ownerName.description: The display name of the card owner.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the request was created.

PaymentRequest.title: Payment Request
PaymentRequest.description: Represents a request from one user for another user to approve a payment from their wallet.

requesterId.description: The UID of the user making the payment request.

requesterName.description: The display name of the user making the request.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns the wallet to be charged.

amount.description: The total amount of the payment.

status.description: The status of the payment request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the request was created.

orderData.description: A snapshot of the order details at the time of request.

Banner.title: Banner
Banner.description: Represents a promotional banner that contains a YouTube video URL.

youtubeUrl.description: The URL of the YouTube video for the banner.

status.description: The status of the banner (active or draft).

isUsed.description: Flag to indicate if the card has been used.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the card was created.

usedBy.description: The UID of the user who redeemed the card.

usedAt.description: The timestamp when the card was redeemed.

userId.description: The ID of the user who placed the order.

userName.description: The name of the user who placed the order.

items.description: List of items in the order.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the order.

status.description: The current status of the order.

paymentMethod.description: The card number used for payment (last 4 digits).

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the order was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public profile information for each user, including their subscriptions array.

/managers/{managerId}.description: Stores profile information for admin users.

/products/{productId}.description: Stores all available products in the application.

/cardLinkRequests/{requestId}.description: Stores requests to link payment cards between users.

/paymentRequests/{requestId}.description: Stores requests for payment approval from another user's wallet.

/banners/{bannerId}.description: Stores promotional banners for the app.

/offers/{offerId}.description: Stores promotional offers for the app.
